Job Description

Job Title: Full Stack Developer (React + Spring Boot)

Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant full stack development experience

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: [Add location / Remote / Hybrid as applicable]

Job Summary:
We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in React (Frontend) and Spring Boot (Backend) to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving skills, practical experience with cloud-based deployments, and a solid understanding of modern DevOps practices.

Key Responsibilities:

Frontend (React):
- Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using React
- Implement reusable components and maintain clean, modular code
- Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs
- Optimize application performance and improve UI/UX
- Debug and resolve frontend issues across browsers and devices

Backend (Spring Boot):
- Design and develop RESTful APIs using Spring Boot
- Implement business logic, validation, and data processing
- Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases
- Ensure application security, scalability, and performance
- Write clean, maintainable, and testable backend code

DevOps & Cloud (AWS):
- Deploy and manage applications on AWS
- Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices
- Monitor application performance and handle production issues
- Work with containerization and infrastructure automation tools as required

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Technical Skills:
- Strong experience with React.js (hooks, state management, component lifecycle)
- Strong experience with Spring Boot and REST API development
- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern ES standards
- Experience with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
- Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
- Experience with AWS cloud services
- Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and application deployment

Certifications (Mandatory):
- AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Associate or Professional)

Educational Qualifications (Mandatory):
- Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Computer Science or Information Technology
OR
- Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Computer Science or Information Technology

Desired Skills (Good to Have):
- Experience with Docker and container-based deployments
- Knowledge of microservices architecture
- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
- Experience with testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, etc.)
